name: DeepSpeed-FastGen: High-throughput Text Generation for LLMs via MII and DeepSpeed-Inference (arXiv 2401.08671)
notes: arXiv cats cs.PF/cs.LG, no venue in comment found. Headline claim from the abstract: up to 2.3x higher effective throughput, 2x lower average latency. Mechanism: Dynamic SplitFuse — composing prompt and generation work into a single dynamically-split inference pass. Venue NOT verified; recorded as arxiv-preprint.
